title: TRINITY ESALC-I single-mode GVPT2 and IR
summary: Acquire complete cubic and semidiagonal quartic, metric and dipole fields with only reference and single-normal-mode displacements; solve Fermi-only curvilinear GVPT2 and IR.
gates: frozen ESALC-I chart and full vibrational rank
Cartesian-to-ESALC-I B/J closure and Wilson GF identity
single-mode plus/minus displacements only for complete F3, semidiagonal F4, G prime and single-mode G double-prime
analytic dipole Jacobians yield D_i,j and D_i,jj; dipole values yield only diagonal derivatives from plus/minus one and two steps
Fermi-only resonance polyads and second-order IR transition moments
coordinate_policy: Use a frozen full-rank ESALC-I chart. Displace plus/minus along one dimensionless normal mode at a time. Set derivative components requiring simultaneous modal displacements to zero.
backend_policy: KeyMaker authorizes Cartesian E/G/H and dipole-value or dipole-Jacobian providers; TRINITY owns single-mode differences, transformation, Fermi-only GVPT2 and IR intensities.
